verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ይኔጽር ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወይሬኢ ፡ ነዋ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ እኁሁ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ወነዋ ፡ አርባዕቱ ፡ ምእት ፡ ዕደው ፡
                  ምስሌሁ ፡ ወነፈቆሙ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለደቂቁ ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ልያ ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ራሔል ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ ዕቁባቲሁ ።
verses.translation: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and beheld, and lo! Esau his brother coming, and four hundred men with him; and Jacob divided the children to Lea and to Rachel, and the two handmaidens.

translations.lxx: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and beheld, and lo! Esau his brother coming, and four hundred men with him; and Jacob divided the children to Lea and to Rachel, and the two handmaidens.
translations.kjv: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
translations.ron: Atunci, ridicându-şi ochii, Iacov a văzut pe Isav, fratele său, venind cu cei patru sute de oameni. Şi a împărţit Iacov copiii Liei şi ai Rahilei şi ai celor două roabe.
translations.grk: Ἀναβλέψας δὲ Ἰακὼβ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ εἶδε· καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἡσαῦ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἐρχόμενος, καὶ τετρακόσιοι ἄνδρες μετʼ αὐτοῦ· καὶ διεῖλεν Ἰακὼβ τὰ παιδία ἐπὶ Λείαν, καὶ ἐπὶ Ῥαχὴλ, καὶ τὰς δύο παιδίσκας.

verses.geez:
[ወረሰዮን ፡ ለዕቁባቲሁ ፡] ምስለ ፡ ደቂቆን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ [ወ]ልያ ፡ ወደቂቃ ፡ ድኅሬሆን ፡ ወራሔል ፡ [ወ]ዮሴፍ ፡
                  ድኅሬሃ ።
verses.translation: And he put the two handmaidens and their children with the first, and Lea and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.

translations.lxx: And he put the two handmaidens and their children with the first, and Lea and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.
translations.kjv: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
translations.ron: Şi a pus pe cele două roabe cu copiii lor înainte; apoi după ei a pus pe Lia cu copiii ei şi la urmă a pus pe Rahila şi pe Iosif;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθετο τὰς δύο παιδίσκας καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν ἐν πρώτοις, καὶ Λείαν καὶ τὰ παιδία αὐτῆς ὀπίσω, καὶ Ῥαχὴλ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ ἐσχάτους.

verses.geez: ወውእቱሰ ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ፡ ሖረ ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ስብዕ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይበጽሕ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እኁሁ ።
verses.translation: But he advanced himself before them, and did reverence to the ground seven times, until he drew near to his brother.

translations.lxx: But he advanced himself before them, and did reverence to the ground seven times, until he drew near to his brother.
translations.kjv: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
translations.ron: Iar el mergea în fruntea lor şi, apropiindu-se de fratele său, i s-a închinat de şapte ori până la pământ.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς δὲ προῆλθεν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν· καὶ προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἑπτάκις, ἕως τοῦ ἐγγίσαι τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወቀደመ ፡ ረዊጸ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ወተቀበሎ ፡ ወሐቀፎ ፡ ክሳዶ ፡ [ወሰዐሞ ፡] ወበከዩ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Esau ran on to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they both wept.

translations.lxx: And Esau ran on to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they both wept.
translations.kjv: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
translations.ron: Isav însă a alergat în întâmpinarea lui şi l-a îmbrăţişat şi, cuprinzându-i grumazul, l-a sărutat şi au plâns amândoi.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσέδραμεν Ἡσαῦ εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ· καὶ περιλαβὼν αὐτὸν προσέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ, καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν· καὶ ἔκλαυσαν ἀμφότεροι.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ነጸረ ፡ ወርእየ ፡ (ክልኤሆን ፡) አንስቲያሁ ፡ ወደቂቆን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ምንትከ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ እሉ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡
                  ደቂቅየ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ዘምሕሮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለገብርከ ።
verses.translation: And Esau looked up and saw the women and the children, and said, What are these to thee? And he said, The children with which God has mercifully blessed thy servant.

translations.lxx: And Esau looked up and saw the women and the children, and said, What are these to thee? And he said, The children with which God has mercifully blessed thy servant.
translations.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
translations.ron: Apoi, ridicându-şi ochii şi văzând femeile şi copiii, Isav a zis: "Cine sunt aceştia?" Zis-a Iacov: "Copiii cu care a miluit Dumnezeu pe robul tău!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναβλέψας Ἡσαῦ εἶδε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ παιδία· καὶ εἶπε, τί ταῦτά σοι ἐστίν; ὁ δὲ εἶπε, τὰ παιδία, οἷς ἠλέησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν παῖδά σου.

verses.geez: ወመጽኣ ፡ ዕቁባቲሁ ፡ ወደቂቆን ፡ ወሰገዳ ።
verses.translation: And the maid-servants and their children drew near and did reverence.

translations.lxx: And the maid-servants and their children drew near and did reverence.
translations.kjv: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
translations.ron: Deci, s-au apropiat întâi roabele cu copiii lor şi s-au închinat.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγγισαν αἱ παιδίσκαι καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν, καὶ προσεκύνησαν.

verses.geez: ወመጽአት ፡ ልያ ፡ ወደቂቃ ፡ ወሰገደት ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ መጽአት ፡ ራሔል ፡ *ወዮሴፍ ፡* ወሰገደት ።
verses.translation: And Lea and her children drew near and did reverence; and after this drew near Rachel and Joseph, and did reverence.

translations.lxx: And Lea and her children drew near and did reverence; and after this drew near Rachel and Joseph, and did reverence.
translations.kjv: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
translations.ron: Apoi a venit Lia cu copiii ei şi s-au închinat, iar la urmă au venit şi s-au închinat şi Rahila cu Iosif.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήγγισε Λεία καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς, καὶ προσεκύνησαν· καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα προσήγγισε Ῥαχὴλ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ, καὶ προσεκύνησαν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ምንትከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተዓይን ፡ [ዘረከብኩ ፡] ወይቤሎ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለዔሰው ፡ ዘገበርኩ ፡ ለከ
                  ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ እርከብ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜከ ።
verses.translation: And he said, What are these things to thee, all these companies that I have met? And he said, That thy servant might find grace in thy sight, my lord.

translations.lxx: And he said, What are these things to thee, all these companies that I have met? And he said, That thy servant might find grace in thy sight, my lord.
translations.kjv: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
translations.ron: Zis-a Isav: "Ce sunt acele turme, pe care le-am întâlnit?" Iar Iacov a răspuns: "Ca să afle robul tău bunăvoinţă înaintea domnului meu".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε, τί ταῦτά σοι ἐστὶν, πᾶσαι αἱ παρεμβολαὶ αὗται, αἷς ἀπήντηκα; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἵνα εὕρῃ ὁ παῖς σου χάριν ἐναντίον σου, κύριε.

verses.geez: ወይቤ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ብየ ፡ አንሰ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ አንተ ፡ እኁየ ፡ ወይኩንከ ፡ ለከ ፡ ዘዚአከ ።
verses.translation: And Esau said, I have much, my brother; keep thine own.

translations.lxx: And Esau said, I have much, my brother; keep thine own.
translations.kjv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
translations.ron: Atunci Isav a zis: "Am şi eu multe, frate; ţine-ţi ale tale pentru tine!"
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἡσαῦ, ἔστι μοι πολλὰ, ἀδελφέ· ἔστω σοι τὰ σά.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ረከብኩ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ ተመጠው ፡ እምነ ፡ እዴየ ፡ አምኃየ ፡ እስመ ፡ በእንተ ፡
                  ዝንቱ ፡ እሬኢ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘይሬኢ ፡ ገጸ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Jacob said, If I have found grace in thy sight, receive the gifts through my hands; therefore have I seen thy face, as if any one should see the face of God, and thou shalt be well-pleased with me.

translations.lxx: And Jacob said, If I have found grace in thy sight, receive the gifts through my hands; therefore have I seen thy face, as if any one should see the face of God, and thou shalt be well-pleased with me.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
translations.ron: Iacov însă a zis: "De am aflat bunăvoinţă înaintea ta, primeşte darurile din mâinile mele, căci, când am văzut faţa ta, parcă aş fi văzut faţa lui Dumnezeu, aşa de binevoitor mi-ai fost.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἰακὼβ, εἰ εὓρον χάριν ἐναντίον σου, δέξαι τὰ δῶρα διὰ τῶν ἐμῶν χειρῶν· ἕνεκεν τούτου εἶδον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου, ὡς ἄν τις ἴδοι πρόσωπον Θεοῦ, καὶ εὐδοκήσεις με.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ታፈቅረኒ ፡ ንሢእ ፡ አምኃየ ፡ ዘአምጻእኩ ፡ ለከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ምሕረኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወብየ ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  ወአገበሮ ፡ ወነሥአ ።
verses.translation: Receive my blessings, which I have brought thee, because God has had mercy on me, and I have all things; and he constrained him, and he took them.

translations.lxx: Receive my blessings, which I have brought thee, because God has had mercy on me, and I have all things; and he constrained him, and he took them.
translations.kjv: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
translations.ron: Primeşte de la mine binecuvântările mele, pe care ţi le aduc, că m-a miluit Dumnezeu şi am de toate". Şi a stăruit şi le-a luat.
translations.grk: Λάβε τὰς εὐλογίας μου, ἃς ἤνεγκά σοι, ὅτι ἠλέησέ με ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ ἔστι μοι πάντα· καὶ ἐβιάσατο αὐτὸν, καὶ ἔλαβε.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ተንሥኡ ፡ ንሑር ፡ እንተ ፡ መንጸር ።
verses.translation: And he said, Let us depart, and proceed right onward.

translations.lxx: And he said, Let us depart, and proceed right onward.
translations.kjv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
translations.ron: Apoi a zis Isav: "Să ne sculăm şi să mergem împreună; eu însă îmi voi potrivi pasul cu tine".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν, ἀπάραντες πορευσώμεθα ἐπʼ εὐθεῖαν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ታአምር ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ድኩማን ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ ወአባግዕ ፡ ወእጕላትኒ ፡ የሐርሣ ፡
                  ላዕሌየ ፡ ወለእመሰ ፡ መረድነ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወእማእኮ ፡ ሰኑየ ፡ ይመውቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እንስሳነ ።
verses.translation: And he said to him, My lord knows, that the children are very tender, and the flocks and the herds with me are with young; if then I shall drive them hard one day, all the cattle will die.

translations.lxx: And he said to him, My lord knows, that the children are very tender, and the flocks and the herds with me are with young; if then I shall drive them hard one day, all the cattle will die.
translations.kjv: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
translations.ron: Iacov însă a răspuns: "Domnul meu ştie că îmi sunt gingaşi copiii şi că am oi şi vite de curând fătate; de le vom mâna tare numai o zi, ar pieri toată turma.
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ αὐτῷ, ὁ κύριός μου γινώσκει, ὅτι τὰ παιδία ἁπαλώτερα, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ αἱ βόες λοχεύονται ἐπʼ ἐμέ· ἐὰν οὖν καταδιώξω αὐτὰ ἡμέραν μίαν, ἀποθανοῦνται πάντα τὰ κτήνη.

verses.geez:
ሑር ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገብርከ ፡ ወንሕነሰ ፡ በከመ ፡ ንክል ፡ ነሐውር ፡ እስመ ፡ ንዋዕልሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ፍኖት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ ወሶበሂ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ በእግረ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ እስከ ፡ ንበጽሕ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ውስተ
                  ፡ ሴይር ።
verses.translation: Let my lord go on before his servant, and I shall have strength on the road according to the ease of the journey before me, and according to the strength of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.

translations.lxx: Let my lord go on before his servant, and I shall have strength on the road according to the ease of the journey before me, and according to the strength of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.
translations.kjv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
translations.ron: Să se ducă dar domnul meu, înaintea robului său, iar eu voi urma încet, în pas cu vitele cele dinaintea mea şi în pas cu copiii, până voi ajunge la domnul meu în Seir".
translations.grk: Προελθέτω ὁ κύριός μου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ· ἐγὼ δὲ ἐνισχύσω ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ κατὰ σχολὴν τῆς πορεύσεως τῆς ἐναντίον μου, καὶ κατὰ πόδα τῶν παιδαρίων, ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν με πρὸς τὸν κύριόν μου εἰς Σηείρ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ እኅድጌ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘምስሌየ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ለምንትኑ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ የአክለኒ ፡
                  ዘረከብኩ ፡ ሞገሰ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.translation: And Esau said, I will leave with thee some of the people who are with me. And he said, Why so? it is enough that I have found favour before thee, my lord.

translations.lxx: And Esau said, I will leave with thee some of the people who are with me. And he said, Why so? it is enough that I have found favour before thee, my lord.
translations.kjv: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
translations.ron: Atunci Isav a zis: "Să-ţi las măcar o parte din oamenii cei ce sunt cu mine". Iar Iacov i-a răspuns: "La ce aceasta? Mi-ajunge mie bunăvoinţa ce-am aflat înaintea domnului meu".
translations.grk: Εἶπε δὲ Ἡσαῦ, καταλείψω μετὰ σοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ μετʼ ἐμοῦ· ὁ δὲ εἶπεν, ἱνατί τοῦτο; ἱκανὸν ὅτι εὗρον χάριν ἐναντίον σου, κύριε.

verses.geez: ወገብአ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ፍኖቶ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሴይር ።
verses.translation: And Esau returned on that day on his journey to Seir.

translations.lxx: And Esau returned on that day on his journey to Seir.
translations.kjv: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
translations.ron: Şi s-a întors Isav în aceeaşi zi pe calea sa la Seir.
translations.grk: Ἀπέστρεψε δὲ Ἡσαῦ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ εἰς Σηείρ.

verses.geez:
ወያዕቆብሰ ፡ ኀደረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተዓይን ፡ ወገብረ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ሐጹረ ፡ ህየ ፡ ሎቱሂ ፡ ወለእንስሳሁ ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ሰመዮ
                  ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ማኅደር ።
verses.translation: And Jacob departs to his tents; and he made for himself there habitations, and for his cattle he made booths; therefore he called the name of that place, Booths.

translations.lxx: And Jacob departs to his tents; and he made for himself there habitations, and for his cattle he made booths; therefore he called the name of that place, Booths.
translations.kjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
translations.ron: Iar Iacov s-a îndreptat spre Sucot şi şi-a făcut acolo locuinţă pentru sine, iar pentru vitele sale a făcut şuri; de aceea a pus el numele locului aceluia Sucot.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἀπαίρει εἰς σκηνὰς, καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ ἐκεῖ οἰκίας, καὶ τοῖς κτήνεσιν αὐτοῦ ἐποίησε σκηνάς· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσε τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου, Σκηναί.

verses.geez:
ወበጽሐ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሴሌም ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ [ሴ]ቄሞን ፡ እንተ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ከናአን ፡
                  ወሶበ ፡ መጽአ ፡ እምነ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ዘሶርያ ፡ ወበጽሐ ፡ አንጻረ ፡ ሀገር ።
verses.translation: And Jacob came to Salem, a city of Secima, which is in the land of Chanaan, when he departed out of Mesopotamia of Syria, and took up a position in front of the city.

translations.lxx: And Jacob came to Salem, a city of Secima, which is in the land of Chanaan, when he departed out of Mesopotamia of Syria, and took up a position in front of the city.
translations.kjv: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
translations.ron: Întorcându-se Iacov din Mesopotamia şi ajungând cu bine la Salem, o cetate în ţinutul Sichem, din pământul Canaan, s-a aşezat în faţa cetăţii.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦλθεν Ἰακὼβ εἰς Σαλὴμ, πόλιν Σηκίμων, ἥ ἐστιν ἐν γῇ Χαναὰν, ὅτε ἐπανῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς Μεσοποταμίας Συρίας· καὶ παρενέλαβε κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς πόλεως.

verses.geez:
ወአኀዘ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ገራህት ፡ ወተከለ ፡ ህየ ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ወገራህታሰ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሣየ[ጠ ፡] እምነ ፡ ኤሞር ፡ አቡሁ
                  ፡ ለሴኬም ፡ በምእት ፡ አባግዕ ።
verses.translation: And he bought the portion of the field, where he pitched his tent, of Emmor the father of Sychem, for a hundred lambs.

translations.lxx: And he bought the portion of the field, where he pitched his tent, of Emmor the father of Sychem, for a hundred lambs.
translations.kjv: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.
translations.ron: Apoi şi-a cumpărat partea de câmp, pe care era cortul său, cu o sută de kesite, de la fiii lui Hemor, tatăl lui Sichem.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκτήσατο τὴν μερίδα τοῦ ἀγροῦ, οὗ ἔστησεν ἐκεῖ τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ, παρὰ Ἐμμὼρ πατρὸς Συχὲμ, ἑκατὸν ἀμνῶν.

verses.geez: ወአቀመ ፡ በህየ ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ወጸውዖ ፡ በህየ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And he set up there an altar, and called on the God of Israel.

translations.lxx: And he set up there an altar, and called on the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.
translations.ron: A înălţat acolo un jertfelnic şi i-a pus numele El-Elohe-Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔστησεν ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο τὸν Θεὸν Ἰσραήλ.
